definition: An underlying layer of feelings that supports a person's thoughts.
author: H. G. Wells
quote: Without the body the brain would, of course, become a mere selfish intelligence, without any of the emotional substratum of the human being.
example_sentence: Beneath the jokes ran a substratum of real panic about the exam.
